Sections.Name: General
Sections.Description: Core NPC speech and dialogue behavior.

Keys.Name: Enabled
Keys.Description: Master switch for NPC speech.

Keys.Name: InterruptOnNewResponse
Keys.Description: A new NPC response interrupts older queued speech.

Keys.Name: StopWhenTalkWindowCloses
Keys.Description: Stop NPC speech when its conversation closes.

Keys.Name: RevealNpcTextWithSpeech
Keys.Description: Reveal NPC dialogue progressively while it is spoken.

Keys.Name: NarrateQuestGiverWindows
Keys.Description: Voice quest-giver offer/follow-up message boxes.

Keys.Name: NarrateCourtJudge
Keys.Description: Voice legal-court/judge narration. Choice buttons remain silent.

Keys.Name: QuestGiverPortraitUI
Keys.Description: Use the enhanced quest conversation portrait/dialogue presentation.

Sections.Name: NPC Voices
Sections.Description: How procedural and authored NPC voices are assigned. An exact Voice Override forces one engine voice ID while preserving NPC role/race processing.

Keys.Name: VoiceOverride
Keys.Description: Optional exact Daggerfall Voice Engine voice ID for every NPC (for example am_granite). Leave blank to use the normal race/gender/role voice system.

Keys.Name: Variation
Keys.Description: Deterministic pitch/speed variation while preserving NPC identity.

Options: Hybrid - pre-generated WAV first, Kokoro fallback
Keys.Name: SpeechSource
Keys.Description: Runtime speech source.

Keys.Name: UseRoleVoiceTypes
Keys.Description: Use social-role profiles such as Merchant, Scholar, Noble, or Judge before broader fallbacks.

Keys.Name: FantasyProcessing
Keys.Description: Strength of non-human/Dunmer fantasy processing.

Keys.Name: IgnorePlayerNameInVoicePackKeys
Keys.Description: Allow authored VoicePack lines to omit the player's name while visible text remains unchanged.

Sections.Name: Speech Style
Sections.Description: Delivery polish without changing quest logic or VoicePack keys.

Keys.Name: EmotionLayer
Keys.Description: Infer restrained delivery from portrait state, dialogue context, and curated defaults.

Keys.Name: EmotionStrength
Keys.Description: Strength of emotional cadence/DSP processing.

Keys.Name: GrammarPolish
Keys.Description: Clean spacing, punctuation, capitalization, and a small set of known vanilla typos before synthesis.

Keys.Name: DisplayPolishedText
Keys.Description: Display the polished delivery string in NPC typewriter/quest dialogue.

Keys.Name: PlayerAskConversationUI
Keys.Description: Compatibility toggle for PlayerVO question narration. Normal Ask/Tell Me About remains visually vanilla; no player portrait is injected into the Tone panel.

Keys.Name: Integration
Keys.Description: Use Dynamic Portraits identity when available.

Keys.Name: EmotionSync
Keys.Description: Use Dynamic Portraits reaction state as a preferred emotional-delivery signal.

Options: Defer NPC speech while portrait audio plays
Skip NPC line if portrait audio plays
Keys.Name: PortraitAudioBehavior
Keys.Description: Avoid talking over portrait-pack greeting/reaction WAVs.

Sections.Name: Audio
Sections.Description: Shared Daggerfall Voice Engine output settings.

Keys.Name: Volume
Keys.Description: NPC voice volume percentage.

Keys.Name: UseGameSoundVolume
Keys.Description: Scale with Daggerfall Unity's normal sound volume.

Keys.Name: AudioStyle
Keys.Description: Shared Kokoro post-processing style.

Keys.Name: AutoStartVoiceEngine
Keys.Description: Automatically launch the bundled Daggerfall Voice Engine when it is not already running.

Keys.Name: EnsureEnglishVoiceLibrary
Keys.Description: On startup, ask Daggerfall Voice Engine to verify its bundled English voice library.

Keys.Name: MaxCacheSize
Keys.Description: Maximum generated NPC speech cache size.
